items.source: Save the Instrumentation interface exposed by the JVM.
items.translation: 保存由 JVM 暴露的 `Instrumentation` 接口。

items.source: Note that this agent class will typically not be available in the classpath unless the agent is actually specified on JVM startup. If you intend to do conditional checking with respect to agent availability, consider using InstrumentationLoadTimeWeaver.getInstrumentation() instead - which will work without the agent class in the classpath as well.
items.translation: 请注意，除非在 JVM 启动时实际指定了该代理，否则通常类路径中不可用此代理类。如果您打算针对代理可用性进行条件检查，请考虑使用 `InstrumentationLoadTimeWeaver.getInstrumentation()`——它即使在没有代理类的类路径下也能正常工作。

items.source: Save the Instrumentation interface exposed by the JVM. This method is required to dynamically load this Agent with the Attach API.
items.translation: 保存由 JVM 公开的 `Instrumentation` 接口。此方法需要使用 Attach API 动态加载该 Agent。

items.source: the Instrumentation instance previously saved when the premain(String, Instrumentation) or agentmain(String, Instrumentation) methods was called by the JVM; will be null if this class was not used as Java agent when this JVM was started or it wasn't installed as agent using the Attach API.
items.translation: 之前保存的 `Instrumentation` 实例，是在 JVM 调用 premain(String, Instrumentation) 或 agentmain(String, Instrumentation) 方法时记录的；如果此类在启动该 JVM 时未作为 Java agent 使用，或未通过 Attach API 安装为 agent，则该实例将为 `null`。

items.source: Java agent that saves the Instrumentation interface from the JVM for later use.
items.translation: Java 代理用于保存来自 JVM 的 Instrumentation 接口，以便稍后使用。

items.source: Return the Instrumentation interface exposed by the JVM.
items.translation: 返回由 JVM 公开的 Instrumentation 接口。
